children: JD Sports Fashion said it entered into a long-term franchise partnership with Mexican retail distributor Grupo Axo, as the British company continues to expand into the North American market.

Mexico offers significant runway for growth, JD said Monday, adding  that the country's activewear market is expected to grow to over $10 billion by 2034, driven by running, football and lifestyle fashion categories.
Starting in 2027, Axo will operate more than 140 JD shops in Mexico. Axo will also run JD's e-commerce channel in the country.

JD Sports last week appointed John Mersho as president and chief executive of the North American division, in a move aimed at capturing the "significant growth opportunity" the group sees in the region. The market accounted for 38% of JD's group sales in the year through January 2026.

title: JD Sports Teams Up With Mexico's Grupo Axo to Boost North America Footprint
